focus: Mozambican tax-benefit surface: IRPS personal income tax (schedules 1 and 3), the ISPC simplified small-taxpayer tax, INSS social insurance contributions, VAT and excises, PSSB and INAS direct social support.
purpose: Household-level comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Mozambique Axiom coverage. None of these are legal authority.
oracle_scope: A RuleSpec oracle must be an executable, pinned external calculator that accepts household-level inputs and returns household-level tax-benefit outputs comparable to Axiom outputs. Aggregate simulators, distributional reports, parameter documentation, and public model summaries are supporting references only, not oracles.

oracles.name: MOZMOD
oracles.dataset: IOF-based input microdata (shipped with the licensed bundle where included)
oracles.role: Household-level tax-benefit comparison oracle for Mozambique. Policy years 2015-24. Report CR-MOZMOD-v3.1 (UNU-WIDER).

availability_check.detail: The locally held licensed SOUTHMOD bundle (EUROMOD runtime proven on the Ghana and Rwanda lanes) must be inventoried for MOZMOD MZ systems before wiring. Validation frame: MOZMOD v3.1, policy years 2015-24.
